title: Learning Experience Designer (f/m/d)
description:
We create digital courses for corporate clients and are growing the design team.

What you'll do
- Turn subject-matter input into engaging blended learning journeys
- Storyboard and build interactive modules in Articulate Storyline or Rise
- Apply adult-learning principles and test with pilot groups
- Collaborate with client stakeholders in English

What you bring
- 4+ years in instructional design or learning experience design
- Portfolio of e-learning projects
- Knowledge of SCORM and an LMS
- English at a professional level
